verdict.rationale: Jan's own docs state that users can click Import Model and select GGUF files from local storage. Its local inference is powered by llama.cpp, and it can download and run LLMs from Hugging Face, so loading and running GGUF models is a first-party capability. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of GGUF quantization variants and runtime options, and independent or hands-on corroboration of running GGUF models.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and run models packaged in the GGUF format

citations.quote: From Local Files: Click Import Model and select your GGUF files.
Jan provides a built-in, OpenAI-compatible API server that runs entirely on your computer, powered by `llama.cpp`.
Local AI Models: Download and run LLMs (Llama, Gemma, Qwen, GPT-oss etc.) from HuggingFace
